## What's new
<!-- fro-bot-narration-v1 -->

OpenCode V2 plugin checks now wait for plugins to become active instead of treating the agent route as a readiness signal. OpenCode 2.2.7 can return from that route before plugins finish loading, so the image smoke test and runtime integration check now poll the plugin endpoint; checks still fail with the missing plugin names if activation does not complete. The shared plugin gate also has a 60-second default timeout, up from 10 seconds. [#2182](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2182)

`isolate-agent` is no longer labeled experimental in the action inputs and setup documentation, following a successful end-to-end run on a GitHub-hosted runner. The documented baseline now explicitly includes `lfs: false` for checkout; checkout with LFS enabled remains outside the supported baseline because it installs local Git filters and hooks. [#2184](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2184)

## What's new
<!-- fro-bot-narration-v1 -->

Hosted checkouts that leave sparse-checkout settings in `.git/config.worktree` no longer fail the `isolate-agent` handoff. The Git metadata audit now accepts the three checkout booleans that control path selection, and regression coverage exercises the same worktree configuration created by `actions/checkout`; checkouts with Git LFS enabled remain unsupported because LFS adds executable config and hooks. [#2177](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2177)


<details><summary>Full changelog</summary>

## What's new
<!-- fro-bot-narration-v1 -->

Hosted checkouts with Git LFS enabled could be rejected when `isolate-agent` audited `.git/config`, preventing sandbox handoff. The allowlist now accepts the inert `lfs.repositoryformatversion` key while continuing to reject LFS URL and filter settings that could affect Git behavior.

Audit refusal also now records existing `.git` metadata before validation, so rollback no longer incorrectly reports a partial cleanup. Regression coverage includes the hosted checkout’s local Git keys and verifies clean rollback on audit refusal. `isolate-agent` remains experimental pending a successful published-install check on the release carrying this fix. [#2175](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2175)


<details><summary>Full changelog</summary>

## What's new
<!-- fro-bot-narration-v1 -->

The Action can now run OpenCode V2 and its tools under a separate, unprivileged user with the opt-in `isolate-agent` input on supported GitHub-hosted Linux runners. The handoff limits access to the checkout and required OpenCode files, then stops sandbox processes and safely restores ownership and Git metadata; if teardown or recovery cannot be confirmed, the run fails without reading or saving the response. Isolation is opt-in and fails closed on unsupported runners or unsafe checkout configuration. [#2168](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2168)

Slow plugin activation could make the OpenCode V2 permission check time out before the model started. The agent-list request now retries HTTP 503 responses and request timeouts within a 30-second deadline, while malformed responses, unrelated network failures, other status codes, and caller aborts still fail immediately; the credential check remains unchanged. [#2174](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2174)

The Action’s Node.js runtime and Docker images move to v24.22.3, a Node.js security release addressing high- and medium-severity HTTP/2 and TLS issues, among other fixes. [#2169](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2169)

## What's new
<!-- fro-bot-narration-v1 -->

The updated Hono release corrects several edge cases that can affect request handling and response safety. It now matches security-cookie prefixes without regard to case, sanitizes non-ASCII API Gateway v2 header values, escapes JSX attribute values, and applies CSP nonces to scripts generated by `ErrorBoundary`. It also fixes URL query-key matching across separators and cancels discarded response bodies. [#2154](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2154)

Systematic v3.32.2 improves the `ce:connect` research workflow: truncated results no longer prematurely stop searching, and dropped candidates are identified in its digest and run record. The update also restores patched Undici for `node-gyp` and raises the required OpenCode v2 version to the one verified by CI. [#2167](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2167)
